Throughout her career, she has worked with major production companies such as Brazzers, Naughty America, Digital Sin, Jules Jordan Video, Elegant Angel, and Evil Angel, collaborating with industry stars like Shyla Stylez, Kelly Divine, and Tori Black.

Her energy is contagious, and her ability to communicate empathy and spontaneity makes her a highly appreciated figure even off-set. She is known for her willingness to respond to messages and fan requests, demonstrating a professional yet very human and approachable attitude.
